messages:
sara: Quick follow-up to the pinning schema RFC. Proposal: add a 'variant consolidation' flag so the control plane can treat small perf/quant-only variant diffs as one logical surface for routing/telemetry for a short TTL to reduce churn.

mike: Interesting. Main risk is hiding semantic drift. Require explicit owner opt-in and a compatibility evidence bundle (eval_id + delta metrics). Audit must still record exact variant hashes per inference.

yun: Agreed. Tenant opt-out is needed (tenant_meta.allow_consolidation = false). Also insist per-variant traces are retained and exportable even when grouped.

kevin: Sketch of minimal rollout fields: consolidation_id (opt), consolidation_ttl_days, consolidation_policy enum("strict","lenient"), evidence_id, allowed_pools list. Implementation detail: compute consolidation_id deterministically (sha256 of owner_id + sorted variant hashes) so replicas and backfill agree.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for variant v5-int8 on canary/2026-04-05 :rocket:

sara: I'll draft a short RFC + data-model PR including deprecation phases (soft_group, notice, hard_retire), revocation_ts, and telemetry requirements: migration_success_rate, latency_p95_delta, cost_delta_per_token, post_consolidation_regressions. Will circulate link when ready.
